import clocks = "./clocks.qui"

int[][] graph(int[][] metadata, int[][] process_events, int[][] copies)
    int[][] edges := [for event := metadata[] then []]
    for: i < int(#metadata)
        event := metadata[i]
        if event[1] < int(#process_events[event[0]])
            edges[i] = edges[i].append(process_events[event[0]][event[1]])
    for copy := copies[]
        if copy[1] >= 0
            edges[copy[0]] = edges[copy[0]].append(copy[1])
    return edges

int[] path(int first, int last, int[][] edges)
    parents := [for i := (0:<int(#edges))[] then -2]
    parents[first] = -1
    queue := [first]
    head := 0
    while head < int(#queue) and parents[last] == -2
        current := queue[head]
        head += 1
        for following := edges[current][]
            if parents[following] == -2
                parents[following] = current
                queue = queue.append(following)
    if parents[last] == -2
        return []
    int[] result := []
    current := last
    while current >= 0
        result = [current].concat(result)
        current = parents[current]
    return result

class Concurrency(int pairs, int ordered, int concurrent, int same_lamport, int inversions, int[][] by_pair)

Concurrency concurrency(int[][] metadata, int[][] vectors, int size)
    count := int(#metadata)
    ordered := 0
    concurrent := 0
    same_lamport := 0
    inversions := 0
    by_pair := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then [for j := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]]
    for: i < count
        for: i + 1 <= j < count
            if clocks.relation(vectors[i], vectors[j]) == "||"
                concurrent += 1
                if metadata[i][3] == metadata[j][3]
                    same_lamport += 1
                first := metadata[i][0]
                second := metadata[j][0]
                if first > second
                    temporary := first
                    first = second
                    second = temporary
                by_pair[first][second] += 1
            else
                ordered += 1
            if (metadata[i][2] - metadata[j][2]) * (metadata[i][3] - metadata[j][3]) < 0
                inversions += 1
    return Concurrency(count * (count - 1) / 2, ordered, concurrent, same_lamport, inversions, by_pair)

class Races(int[][] races, int[][] violations, int fifo)

Races races(int[][] deliveries, int[][] copies, int[][] vectors)
    int[][] race_rows := []
    int[][] violations := []
    fifo := 0
    for: p < int(#deliveries)
        delivered := deliveries[p]
        for: i < int(#delivered) - 1
            first := delivered[i]
            second := delivered[i + 1]
            if clocks.relation(vectors[copies[first][0]], vectors[copies[second][0]]) == "||"
                race_rows = race_rows.append([p, first, second])
            for: i + 1 <= j < int(#delivered)
                later := delivered[j]
                if clocks.before(vectors[copies[later][0]], vectors[copies[first][0]])
                    violations = violations.append([p, first, later])
                    if copies[first][1] == copies[later][1]
                        fifo += 1
    return Races(race_rows, violations, fifo)

bool consistent(int[] cut, int[][] process_events, int[][] vectors)
    for: p < int(#cut)
        if cut[p] > 0 and not clocks.less_equal(vectors[process_events[p][cut[p] - 1]], cut)
            return false
    return true

class Enumeration(int[] limits, int product, int consistent_count, int[] levels, int[][] predicates)

Enumeration enumerate(int[][] process_events, int[][] metadata, int[][] vectors, int[] initial, int limit, int[] thresholds)
    size := int(#initial)
    int[] limits := []
    int[] multipliers := []
    product := 1
    level_count := 0
    initial_total := 0
    for: p < size
        count := 0
        for event := process_events[p][]
            if metadata[event][2] <= limit
                count += 1
        limits = limits.append(count)
        multipliers = multipliers.append(product)
        product *= count + 1
        level_count += count
        initial_total += initial[p]
    levels := [for i := (0:<(int(level_count) + 1))[] then 0]
    valid := [for i := (0:<int(product))[] then false]
    amounts := [for i := (0:<int(product))[] then 0]
    counts := [for threshold := thresholds[] then 0]
    consistent_count := 0
    for: code < product
        int[] cut := []
        level := 0
        balance := 0
        for: p < size
            count := (code / multipliers[p]) % (limits[p] + 1)
            cut = cut.append(count)
            level += count
            balance += if count == 0 then initial[p] else metadata[process_events[p][count - 1]][4]
        if consistent(cut, process_events, vectors)
            valid[code] = true
            amounts[code] = initial_total - balance
            consistent_count += 1
            levels[level] += 1
            for: i < int(#thresholds)
                if amounts[code] >= thresholds[i]
                    counts[i] += 1
    int[][] predicates := []
    for: i < int(#thresholds)
        threshold := thresholds[i]
        reachable := [for code := (0:<int(product))[] then code == 0]
        avoids := false
        for: code < product
            if reachable[code] and valid[code] and amounts[code] < threshold
                if code == product - 1
                    avoids = true
                for: p < size
                    if (code / multipliers[p]) % (limits[p] + 1) < limits[p]
                        following := code + multipliers[p]
                        if valid[following]
                            reachable[following] = true
        predicates = predicates.append([counts[i], (if counts[i] > 0 then 1 else 0), (if avoids then 0 else 1)])
    return Enumeration(limits, product, consistent_count, levels, predicates)

void local_event(int &lamport, int[] &vector, int own)
    lamport += 1
    vector[own] += 1

void receive_event(int &lamport, int[] &vector, int own, int sending_lamport, int[] sending_vector)
    lamport = (if lamport > sending_lamport then lamport else sending_lamport) + 1
    for: i < int(#vector)
        if sending_vector[i] > vector[i]
            vector[i] = sending_vector[i]
    vector[own] += 1

bool less_equal(int[] first, int[] second)
    for: i < int(#first)
        if first[i] > second[i]
            return false
    return true

bool before(int[] first, int[] second)
    return first != second and less_equal(first, second)

string relation(int[] first, int[] second)
    return if before(first, second) then "->" elif before(second, first) then "<-" else "||"

bool deliverable(int[] stamp, int[] broadcast, int source)
    for: i < int(#stamp)
        if i == source
            if stamp[i] != broadcast[i] + 1
                return false
        elif stamp[i] > broadcast[i]
            return false
    return true

int[] missing(int[] stamp, int[] broadcast, int source)
    int[] result := []
    for: i < int(#stamp)
        if stamp[i] > broadcast[i] + (if i == source then 1 else 0)
            result = result.append(i)
    return result

string text(int[] vector)
    return [for value := vector[] then string(value)].join(",")

import collections
import network = "./network.qui"
import clocks = "./clocks.qui"
import processes = "./processes.qui"
import snapshots = "./snapshot.qui"
import analysis = "./analysis.qui"

string[] event_kind_names()
    return ["LOCAL", "NOFUNDS", "SEND", "BCAST", "RECV"]

int minimum(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b

int maximum(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b

string yes(bool value)
    return if value then "yes" else "no"

string message_name(int id)
    return "m{id + 1}"

string words(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then string(value)].join(" ")

int sum(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

class Params(int seed, int end_at, int cutcount, string[][] comparisons, int[][] cuts, int[] predicates)

Params load_params()
    string content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/params.txt"))
    rows := content.split(NL)
    seed := 0
    end_at := 0
    cutcount := 0
    string[][] comparisons := []
    int[][] cuts := []
    int[] predicates := []
    for row := rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1][]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        key := fields[0]
        if key == "SEED"
            seed = network.integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "END"
            end_at = network.integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "CUTCOUNT"
            cutcount = network.integer(fields[1])
        elif key == "COMPARE"
            comparisons = comparisons.append(fields[1:<3])
        elif key == "CUT"
            cuts = cuts.append([for field := fields[1:<int(#fields)][] then network.integer(field)])
        else
            predicates = predicates.append(network.integer(fields[1]))
    return Params(seed, end_at, cutcount, comparisons, cuts, predicates)

class Event(int process_index, int local_number, int kind, int occurred_at, int lamport, int[] vector, int balance, int message, int packet, int destination, int amount, string label)
class Message(bool broadcast, int source, string tag, int amount, int[] stamp, int sent_at, int send_event)
    int[] copies := []

class Packet(bool marker, int snapshot_index, int source, int destination, int message, int send_event)
    sequence := 0
    dispatched_at := 0
    arrives_at := 0
    delivered_at := -1
    recv_event := -1
    fifo_wait := false
    causal_wait := false
    int[] missing := []

class Item(int occurs_at, int process_index, int creation, int packet, processes.Action action)

bool item_less(Item first, Item second)
    if first.occurs_at != second.occurs_at
        return first.occurs_at < second.occurs_at
    if first.process_index != second.process_index
        return first.process_index < second.process_index
    return first.creation < second.creation

class Simulation(network.Topology topology, processes.Script[] scripts, Params params, bool raw)
    size := int(#topology.names)
    processes.State[] states := [for script := scripts[] then processes.State(script, size)]
    network.Channel[] channels := topology.channels
    generator := network.Generator(params.seed)
    Item[] queue := []
    creation := 0
    now := 0
    Message[] messages := []
    Packet[] packets := []
    int[] copies := []
    Event[] events := []
    snapshots.Snapshot[] shots := []
    int[][] timeline := []

    void .enqueue(int at, int process_index, int packet, processes.Action action)
        creation += 1
        item := Item(at, process_index, creation, packet, action)
        index := int(#queue)
        queue = queue.append(item)
        while index > 0
            parent := (index - 1) / 2
            if not item_less(item, queue[parent])
                break
            queue[index] = queue[parent]
            index = parent
        queue[index] = item

    Item .pop()
        result := queue[0]
        last := queue[-1]
        queue = queue[0:<int(#queue) - 1]
        if #queue > 0
            index := 0
            while 2 * index + 1 < int(#queue)
                child := 2 * index + 1
                if child + 1 < int(#queue) and item_less(queue[child + 1], queue[child])
                    child += 1
                if not item_less(queue[child], last)
                    break
                queue[index] = queue[child]
                index = child
            queue[index] = last
        return result

    void .schedule()
        for entry := processes.expand(states, params.end_at)[]
            .enqueue(entry[0], entry[1], -1, states[entry[1]].script.at[entry[2]].action)

    void .dispatch(int packet_index)
        packet := packets[packet_index]
        channel := packet.source * size + packet.destination
        int[] vector := if packet.marker then [] else events[packet.send_event].vector
        result := network.dispatch(&channels[channel], now, packet.marker, vector, &generator)
        packets[packet_index].sequence = result[0]
        packets[packet_index].dispatched_at = now
        packets[packet_index].arrives_at = result[1]
        .enqueue(result[1], packet.destination, packet_index, processes.Action("LOCAL", -1, "", 0))

    int .record_event(int process_index, int kind, int message, int packet, int destination, int amount, string label, int sending)
        if kind == 4
            clocks.receive_event(&states[process_index].lamport, &states[process_index].vector, process_index, events[sending].lamport, events[sending].vector)
        else
            clocks.local_event(&states[process_index].lamport, &states[process_index].vector, process_index)
        index := int(#events)
        state := states[process_index]
        events = events.append(Event(process_index, int(#state.events) + 1, kind, now, state.lamport, state.vector, state.balance, message, packet, destination, amount, label))
        states[process_index].events = states[process_index].events.append(index)
        states[process_index].counts[kind] += 1
        if state.balance < state.minimum
            states[process_index].minimum = state.balance
        timeline = timeline.append([0, index, process_index, now])
        return index

    void .record_snapshot(int shot, int process_index, string reason)
        state := states[process_index]
        snapshots.capture(&shots[shot], process_index, now, reason, state.balance, state.lamport, state.vector, state.holdback)
        timeline = timeline.append([1, shot, process_index, now])
        for: destination < size
            if destination != process_index
                channel := process_index * size + destination
                shots[shot].marker_sent[channel] = now
                packets = packets.append(Packet(true, shot, process_index, destination, -1, -1))
                .dispatch(int(#packets) - 1)

    void .initiate(int process_index, string name)
        shot := -1
        for: i < int(#shots)
            if shots[i].name == name
                shot = i
        if shot < 0
            shot = int(#shots)
            shots = shots.append(snapshots.Snapshot(name, now, size))
        if shots[shot].records[process_index].valid
            shots[shot].ignored = shots[shot].ignored.append([process_index, now])
        else
            .record_snapshot(shot, process_index, "initiate")

    void .send(int process_index, processes.Action action, int sender)
        destination := if action.destination < 0 then sender else action.destination
        amount := action.amount
        tag := action.text
        broadcast := action.kind == "BROADCAST"
        if action.kind == "TRANSFER"
            if amount > states[process_index].balance
                states[process_index].refused += 1
                .record_event(process_index, 1, -1, -1, destination, amount, "", -1)
                return
            states[process_index].balance -= amount
            states[process_index].sent += amount
        if broadcast
            states[process_index].broadcast[process_index] += 1
        message_index := int(#messages)
        int sending := .record_event(process_index, (if broadcast then 3 else 2), message_index, -1, destination, amount, "", -1)
        int[] stamp := if broadcast then states[process_index].broadcast else []
        messages = messages.append(Message(broadcast, process_index, tag, amount, stamp, now, sending))
        for: target < size
            if (broadcast and target != process_index) or (not broadcast and target == destination)
                packet_index := int(#packets)
                packets = packets.append(Packet(false, -1, process_index, target, message_index, sending))
                copies = copies.append(packet_index)
                messages[message_index].copies = messages[message_index].copies.append(packet_index)
                .dispatch(packet_index)

    void .action(int process_index, processes.Action command, int sender)
        if command.kind == "LOCAL"
            .record_event(process_index, 0, -1, -1, -1, 0, command.text, -1)
        elif command.kind == "SNAPSHOT"
            .initiate(process_index, command.text)
        else
            .send(process_index, command, sender)

    void .accept_marker(int process_index, int packet_index)
        packet := packets[packet_index]
        shot := packet.snapshot_index
        if not shots[shot].records[process_index].valid
            .record_snapshot(shot, process_index, "marker " + topology.names[packet.source])
        snapshots.accept(&shots[shot], packet.source * size + process_index, now)

    void .deliver(int process_index, int packet_index)
        packet := packets[packet_index]
        message := messages[packet.message]
        if message.broadcast
            states[process_index].broadcast[packet.source] += 1
        states[process_index].balance += message.amount
        states[process_index].received += message.amount
        int event_index := .record_event(process_index, 4, packet.message, packet_index, -1, message.amount, "", packet.send_event)
        packets[packet_index].recv_event = event_index
        packets[packet_index].delivered_at = now
        states[process_index].delivered = states[process_index].delivered.append(packet_index)
        for rule := states[process_index].script.on[]
            if rule.tag == message.tag
                .action(process_index, rule.action, packet.source)

    bool can_deliver(int process_index, int packet_index)
        packet := packets[packet_index]
        return clocks.deliverable(messages[packet.message].stamp, states[process_index].broadcast, packet.source)

    void .release(int process_index)
        while true
            found := -1
            for: i < int(#states[process_index].holdback)
                if can_deliver(process_index, states[process_index].holdback[i])
                    found = i
                    break
            if found < 0
                break
            packet_index := states[process_index].holdback[found]
            held := states[process_index].holdback
            states[process_index].holdback = held[0:<found].concat(held[found + 1:<int(#held)])
            .deliver(process_index, packet_index)

    void .accept(int process_index, int packet_index)
        packet := packets[packet_index]
        source := packet.source
        states[process_index].next_sequence[source] += 1
        if packet.marker
            .accept_marker(process_index, packet_index)
            return
        channel := source * size + process_index
        for: shot < int(#shots)
            if shots[shot].records[process_index].valid and shots[shot].marker_accepted[channel] < 0
                shots[shot].states[channel] = shots[shot].states[channel].append(packet_index)
        if not messages[packet.message].broadcast or raw
            .deliver(process_index, packet_index)
        elif can_deliver(process_index, packet_index)
            .deliver(process_index, packet_index)
            .release(process_index)
        else
            packets[packet_index].causal_wait = true
            packets[packet_index].missing = clocks.missing(messages[packet.message].stamp, states[process_index].broadcast, source)
            states[process_index].holdback = states[process_index].holdback.append(packet_index)

    void .receive(int process_index, int packet_index)
        packet := packets[packet_index]
        source := packet.source
        if raw
            .accept(process_index, packet_index)
        elif packet.sequence != states[process_index].next_sequence[source]
            packets[packet_index].fifo_wait = true
            states[process_index].reorder[source] = states[process_index].reorder[source].append(packet_index)
            channels[source * size + process_index].buffered += 1
        else
            .accept(process_index, packet_index)
            while true
                found := -1
                for: i < int(#states[process_index].reorder[source])
                    buffered := states[process_index].reorder[source][i]
                    if packets[buffered].sequence == states[process_index].next_sequence[source]
                        found = i
                        break
                if found < 0
                    break
                buffer := states[process_index].reorder[source]
                following := buffer[found]
                states[process_index].reorder[source] = buffer[0:<found].concat(buffer[found + 1:<int(#buffer)])
                .accept(process_index, following)
        held := processes.held_count(states[process_index])
        if held > states[process_index].max_held
            states[process_index].max_held = held

    void .run()
        while #queue > 0 and queue[0].occurs_at <= params.end_at
            Item item := .pop()
            now = item.occurs_at
            if item.packet >= 0
                .receive(item.process_index, item.packet)
            else
                .action(item.process_index, item.action, -1)

int initial_total(Simulation sim)
    return sum([for state := sim.states[] then state.initial])

string event_name(Event event, string[] names)
    return names[event.process_index] + ".{event.local_number}"

int[][] metadata(Simulation sim)
    return [for event := sim.events[] then [event.process_index, event.local_number, event.occurred_at, event.lamport, event.balance]]

int[][] vectors(Simulation sim)
    return [for event := sim.events[] then event.vector]

int[][] process_events(Simulation sim)
    return [for state := sim.states[] then state.events]

int[][] balances(Simulation sim)
    return [for state := sim.states[] then [for index := state.events[] then sim.events[index].balance]]

int[][] copy_details(Simulation sim)
    int[][] result := []
    for index := sim.copies[]
        packet := sim.packets[index]
        result = result.append([packet.source, packet.destination, sim.events[packet.send_event].local_number, (if packet.recv_event < 0 then 0 else sim.events[packet.recv_event].local_number), sim.messages[packet.message].amount])
    return result

snapshots.Details cut_details(Simulation sim, int[] cut)
    return snapshots.details(cut, copy_details(sim), balances(sim), [for state := sim.states[] then state.initial])

int delivered_count(Simulation sim)
    result := 0
    for index := sim.copies[]
        if sim.packets[index].recv_event >= 0
            result += 1
    return result

string names_text(string[] names, int[] indices)
    return [for index := indices[] then names[index]].join(",")

string event_line(Event event, string[] names, Simulation sim)
    event_types := event_kind_names()
    information := ""
    if event.kind == 0
        information = event.label
    elif event.kind == 1
        information = "to {names[event.destination]} amount {event.amount} balance {event.balance}"
    elif event.kind == 2 or event.kind == 3
        message := sim.messages[event.message]
        information = message_name(event.message)
        if event.kind == 2
            information += " to {names[event.destination]}"
        information += " tag {message.tag}"
        if message.amount > 0
            information += " amount {message.amount} balance {event.balance}"
    else
        packet := sim.packets[event.packet]
        message := sim.messages[packet.message]
        information = message_name(packet.message) + " from {names[packet.source]} tag {message.tag}"
        if message.amount > 0
            information += " amount {message.amount} balance {event.balance}"
    return "t={event.occurred_at} " + event_name(event, names) + " {event_types[event.kind]} {information} L={event.lamport} V=" + clocks.text(event.vector)

string[] trace_lines(Simulation sim)
    lines := [for i := (0:<int(#sim.events))[] then "{i + 1} " + event_line(sim.events[i], sim.topology.names, sim)]
    delivered := delivered_count(sim)
    lines = lines.append("SUMMARY events {#sim.events} messages {#sim.messages} copies {#sim.copies} delivered {delivered} undelivered {int(#sim.copies) - delivered} draws {sim.generator.draws}")
    for: p < sim.size
        state := sim.states[p]
        lines = lines.append("FINAL {sim.topology.names[p]} events {#state.events} L={state.lamport} V=" + clocks.text(state.vector) + " B=" + clocks.text(state.broadcast) + " balance {state.balance} in {state.received} out {state.sent} refused {state.refused} min {state.minimum}")
    for: p < sim.size
        int[] counts := sim.states[p].counts
        lines = lines.append("COUNTS {sim.topology.names[p]} local {counts[0]} nofunds {counts[1]} send {counts[2]} bcast {counts[3]} recv {counts[4]}")
    return lines

string wait_mode(Packet packet, string[] names)
    if not packet.causal_wait
        return if packet.fifo_wait then "fifo" else "direct"
    return (if packet.fifo_wait then "fifo+causal " else "causal ") + names_text(names, packet.missing)

int[] broadcast_history(Simulation sim, int process_index)
    int[] result := []
    for index := sim.states[process_index].events[]
        event := sim.events[index]
        if event.kind == 3 or (event.kind == 4 and sim.messages[event.message].broadcast)
            result = result.append(event.message)
    return result

int index_of(int[] values, int key)
    for: i < int(#values)
        if values[i] == key
            return i
    return -1

string[] deliveries_lines(Simulation sim)
    string[] lines := []
    int[][] histories := []
    for: p < sim.size
        state := sim.states[p]
        lines = lines.append("PROCESS {sim.topology.names[p]}")
        modes := [0, 0, 0, 0]
        total_wait := 0
        max_wait := 0
        for: number < int(#state.delivered)
            packet := sim.packets[state.delivered[number]]
            message := sim.messages[packet.message]
            wait := packet.delivered_at - packet.arrives_at
            total_wait += wait
            max_wait = maximum(max_wait, wait)
            modes[(if packet.fifo_wait then 1 else 0) + (if packet.causal_wait then 2 else 0)] += 1
            kind := if message.broadcast then "BCAST" else "P2P"
            lines = lines.append("{number + 1} " + message_name(packet.message) + " from {sim.topology.names[packet.source]} {kind} tag {message.tag} sent {message.sent_at} arrived {packet.arrives_at} delivered {packet.delivered_at} wait {wait} " + wait_mode(packet, sim.topology.names))
        for packet_index := sim.copies[]
            packet := sim.packets[packet_index]
            message := sim.messages[packet.message]
            if packet.destination == p and packet.arrives_at <= sim.params.end_at and packet.recv_event < 0
                place := if index_of(state.reorder[packet.source], packet_index) >= 0 then "fifo" else "causal " + names_text(sim.topology.names, packet.missing)
                kind := if message.broadcast then "BCAST" else "P2P"
                lines = lines.append("HELD " + message_name(packet.message) + " from {sim.topology.names[packet.source]} {kind} tag {message.tag} sent {message.sent_at} arrived {packet.arrives_at} {place}")
        for packet_index := sim.copies[]
            packet := sim.packets[packet_index]
            if packet.destination == p and packet.arrives_at > sim.params.end_at
                message := sim.messages[packet.message]
                kind := if message.broadcast then "BCAST" else "P2P"
                lines = lines.append("TRANSIT " + message_name(packet.message) + " from {sim.topology.names[packet.source]} {kind} tag {message.tag} sent {message.sent_at} arrival {packet.arrives_at}")
        lines = lines.append("TOTAL delivered {#state.delivered} direct {modes[0]} fifo {modes[1]} causal {modes[2]} both {modes[3]} wait {total_wait} max_wait {max_wait} max_held {state.max_held}")
        history := broadcast_history(sim, p)
        histories = histories.append(history)
        lines = lines.append("BCASTS " + (if #history == 0 then "none" else [for id := history[] then message_name(id)].join(" ")))
    for channel_index := sim.topology.order[]
        channel := sim.channels[channel_index]
        kind := if channel.fifo then "FIFO" else "NONFIFO"
        lines = lines.append("CHANNEL {sim.topology.names[channel.source]}->{sim.topology.names[channel.destination]} {kind} " + network.delay_text(channel) + " messages {channel.messages} markers {channel.markers} buffered {channel.buffered} max_delay {channel.max_delay} entries {channel.entries}")
    distinct<string> tags
    for packet_index := sim.copies[]
        .tags.add(sim.messages[sim.packets[packet_index].message].tag)
    for tag := tags.sorted()[]
        copies := 0
        delivered := 0
        latency := 0
        longest := 0
        for packet_index := sim.copies[]
            packet := sim.packets[packet_index]
            message := sim.messages[packet.message]
            if message.tag == tag
                copies += 1
                if packet.recv_event >= 0
                    delivered += 1
                    elapsed := packet.delivered_at - message.sent_at
                    latency += elapsed
                    longest = maximum(longest, elapsed)
        lines = lines.append("TAG {tag} copies {copies} delivered {delivered} latency {latency} max {longest}")
    int[] broadcasts := []
    for: i < int(#sim.messages)
        message := sim.messages[i]
        if message.broadcast
            broadcasts = broadcasts.append(i)
            complete := true
            latest := 0
            for packet_index := message.copies[]
                if sim.packets[packet_index].recv_event < 0
                    complete = false
                else
                    latest = maximum(latest, sim.packets[packet_index].delivered_at)
            stable := if complete then string(latest) else "none"
            lines = lines.append("STABLE " + message_name(i) + " {sim.topology.names[message.source]} tag {message.tag} sent {message.sent_at} stable {stable}")
    disagreements := 0
    for: i < int(#broadcasts)
        for: i + 1 <= j < int(#broadcasts)
            first := broadcasts[i]
            second := broadcasts[j]
            int[] earlier := []
            int[] later := []
            for: p < sim.size
                a := index_of(histories[p], first)
                b := index_of(histories[p], second)
                if a >= 0 and b >= 0
                    if a < b
                        earlier = earlier.append(p)
                    else
                        later = later.append(p)
            if #earlier > 0 and #later > 0
                disagreements += 1
                lines = lines.append("DISAGREE " + message_name(first) + " " + message_name(second) + " " + names_text(sim.topology.names, earlier) + " " + names_text(sim.topology.names, later))
    return lines.append("DISAGREEMENTS {disagreements}")

string copy_label(Simulation sim, int copy_index)
    packet := sim.packets[sim.copies[copy_index]]
    return message_name(packet.message) + "->" + sim.topology.names[packet.destination]

string verdict(snapshots.Details details, Simulation sim)
    if #details.orphans == 0
        return "yes"
    return "no " + [for index := details.orphans[] then copy_label(sim, index)].join(" ")

string[] snapshots_lines(Simulation normal, Simulation raw)
    string[] lines := []
    for: run_index < 2
        sim := if run_index == 0 then normal else raw
        initial := initial_total(sim)
        for shot := sim.shots[]
            cut := snapshots.snapshot_cut(shot)
            details := cut_details(sim, cut)
            recorded := snapshots.recorded(shot, sim.topology.order)
            entries := recorded[0]
            pending := recorded[1]
            channels_total := 0
            balance_total := 0
            for packet_index := entries[]
                channels_total += sim.messages[sim.packets[packet_index].message].amount
            for record := shot.records[]
                balance_total += record.balance
            money := balance_total + channels_total
            if run_index == 1
                lines = lines.append("RAW {shot.name} completed {shot.complete} cut " + clocks.text(cut) + " consistent " + verdict(details, sim) + " money {money} conserved " + yes(money == initial))
            else
                lines = lines.append("SNAPSHOT {shot.name} started {shot.start} completed {shot.complete}")
                for: p < sim.size
                    snapshots.Record record := shot.records[p]
                    pending_text := if #record.pending == 0 then "none" else [for index := record.pending[] then message_name(sim.packets[index].message)].join(" ")
                    lines = lines.append("RECORD {sim.topology.names[p]} t={record.recorded_at} {record.reason} balance {record.balance} L={record.lamport} V=" + clocks.text(record.vector) + " pending {pending_text}")
                for channel := sim.topology.order[]
                    string[] values := []
                    for packet_index := shot.states[channel][]
                        packet := sim.packets[packet_index]
                        amount := sim.messages[packet.message].amount
                        values = values.append(message_name(packet.message) + (if amount == 0 then "" else ":{amount}"))
                    state := if #values == 0 then "empty" else values.join(" ")
                    source := channel / sim.size
                    destination := channel % sim.size
                    lines = lines.append("CHANNEL {sim.topology.names[source]}->{sim.topology.names[destination]} marker {shot.marker_sent[channel]} {shot.marker_accepted[channel]} state {state}")
                for ignored := shot.ignored[]
                    lines = lines.append("IGNORED {sim.topology.names[ignored[0]]} t={ignored[1]}")
                transit := [for index := details.transit[] then sim.copies[index]]
                lines = lines.concat(["CUT " + clocks.text(cut) + " consistent " + verdict(details, sim) + " vector " + yes(snapshots.vector_consistent(shot, cut)),
                    "TRANSIT channels {#entries} pending {#pending} cut {#transit} match " + yes(snapshots.transit_match(entries, pending, transit)),
                    "MONEY balances {balance_total} channels {channels_total} total {money} initial {initial} conserved " + yes(money == initial)])
    return lines

string range_notation(int[] path, Simulation sim)
    if #path == 0
        return "-"
    string[] result := []
    first := path[0]
    last := first
    for: 1 <= i < int(#path)
        event := sim.events[path[i]]
        previous := sim.events[last]
        if event.process_index == previous.process_index and event.local_number == previous.local_number + 1
            last = path[i]
        else
            result = result.append(event_name(sim.events[first], sim.topology.names) + (if first == last then "" else "-{sim.events[last].local_number}"))
            first = path[i]
            last = first
    result = result.append(event_name(sim.events[first], sim.topology.names) + (if first == last then "" else "-{sim.events[last].local_number}"))
    return result.join(" ")

int[] longest_chain(Simulation sim)
    current := 0
    for: i < int(#sim.events)
        if sim.events[i].lamport > sim.events[current].lamport
            current = i
    result := [current]
    while sim.events[current].lamport > 1
        event := sim.events[current]
        previous := -1
        if event.kind == 4
            sending := sim.packets[event.packet].send_event
            if sim.events[sending].lamport == event.lamport - 1
                previous = sending
        if previous < 0
            previous = sim.states[event.process_index].events[event.local_number - 2]
        result = [previous].concat(result)
        current = previous
    return result

int[][] graph_copies(Simulation sim)
    return [for index := sim.copies[] then [sim.packets[index].send_event, sim.packets[index].recv_event]]

int[][] race_copies(Simulation sim)
    return [for packet := sim.packets[] then [packet.send_event, packet.source]]

analysis.Races race_summary(Simulation sim)
    return analysis.races([for state := sim.states[] then state.delivered], race_copies(sim), vectors(sim))

int find_event(Simulation sim, string name)
    for: i < int(#sim.events)
        if event_name(sim.events[i], sim.topology.names) == name
            return i
    return -1

string[] compare_lines(Simulation sim)
    edges := analysis.graph(metadata(sim), process_events(sim), graph_copies(sim))
    string[] lines := []
    for pair := sim.params.comparisons[]
        first := find_event(sim, pair[0])
        second := find_event(sim, pair[1])
        relation := clocks.relation(sim.events[first].vector, sim.events[second].vector)
        path := analysis.path(first, second, edges)
        graph_relation := "->"
        if #path == 0
            path = analysis.path(second, first, edges)
            graph_relation = if #path == 0 then "||" else "<-"
        lines = lines.append("COMPARE {pair[0]} {relation} {pair[1]} L={sim.events[first].lamport},{sim.events[second].lamport} graph {graph_relation} agree " + yes(relation == graph_relation))
        if #path > 0
            messages := 0
            for: 1 <= i < int(#path)
                if sim.events[path[i - 1]].process_index != sim.events[path[i]].process_index
                    messages += 1
            lines = lines.append("PATH length {#path} messages {messages} " + range_notation(path, sim))
        for event_index := [first, second][]
            event := sim.events[event_index]
            int[] future := []
            for state := sim.states[]
                count := 0
                for candidate := state.events[]
                    if sim.events[candidate].vector[event.process_index] < event.local_number
                        count += 1
                future = future.append(count)
            lines = lines.append("WINDOW " + event_name(event, sim.topology.names) + " past " + clocks.text(event.vector) + " future " + clocks.text(future))
    return lines

string[] analysis_lines(Simulation sim, Simulation raw)
    lines := compare_lines(sim)
    concurrency := analysis.concurrency(metadata(sim), vectors(sim), sim.size)
    lines = lines.append("CONCURRENCY events {#sim.events} pairs {concurrency.pairs} ordered {concurrency.ordered} concurrent {concurrency.concurrent} same_lamport {concurrency.same_lamport} inversions {concurrency.inversions}")
    for: p < sim.size
        for: p + 1 <= q < sim.size
            lines = lines.append("PAIR {sim.topology.names[p]} {sim.topology.names[q]} {concurrency.by_pair[p][q]}")
    chain := longest_chain(sim)
    lines = lines.append("CHAIN length {#chain} " + range_notation(chain, sim))
    races := race_summary(sim)
    for race := races.races[]
        first := sim.packets[race[1]]
        second := sim.packets[race[2]]
        lines = lines.append("RACE {sim.topology.names[race[0]]} " + message_name(first.message) + " {sim.topology.names[first.source]} " + message_name(second.message) + " {sim.topology.names[second.source]}")
    lines = lines.append("RACES {#races.races}")
    for violation := races.violations[]
        first := sim.packets[violation[1]]
        second := sim.packets[violation[2]]
        lines = lines.append("VIOLATION {sim.topology.names[violation[0]]} " + message_name(first.message) + " {sim.topology.names[first.source]} overtook " + message_name(second.message) + " {sim.topology.names[second.source]}")
    lines = lines.append("VIOLATIONS causal {#races.violations} fifo {races.fifo}")
    raw_races := race_summary(raw)
    lines = lines.append("RAW events {#raw.events} delivered {delivered_count(raw)} causal {#raw_races.violations} fifo {raw_races.fifo}")
    for cut := sim.params.cuts[]
        details := cut_details(sim, cut)
        text := "CUT " + clocks.text(cut)
        if #details.orphans == 0
            text += " consistent"
        else
            text += " inconsistent orphans " + [for index := details.orphans[] then copy_label(sim, index)].join(" ")
        lines = lines.append(text + " transit {#details.transit} money {details.money} initial {initial_total(sim)}")
    enumeration := analysis.enumerate(process_events(sim), metadata(sim), vectors(sim), [for state := sim.states[] then state.initial], sim.params.cutcount, sim.params.predicates)
    lines = lines.append("CUTCOUNT t={sim.params.cutcount} events " + clocks.text(enumeration.limits) + " product {enumeration.product} consistent {enumeration.consistent_count}")
    lines = lines.append("LEVELS " + words(enumeration.levels))
    for: i < int(#sim.params.predicates)
        predicate := enumeration.predicates[i]
        lines = lines.append("PREDICATE transit>={sim.params.predicates[i]} cuts {predicate[0]} possibly " + yes(predicate[1] == 1) + " definitely " + yes(predicate[2] == 1))
    return lines

void put(string[] &line, int position, string text)
    for: i < int(#text)
        while int(#line) <= position + i
            line = line.append(" ")
        line[position + i] = text[i]

string trimmed(string[] line)
    while #line > 0 and line[-1] == " "
        line = line[0:<int(#line) - 1]
    return line.join("")

string diagram_header(string letter, string[] names)
    string[] line := []
    put(&line, 0, "    {letter} ")
    for: p < int(#names)
        put(&line, 8 * p + 6, names[p])
    return trimmed(line)

string diagram_entry(int value, int process_index, int kind, int message, int source, string shot_name, Simulation sim)
    string[] line := []
    number := string(value)
    put(&line, 0, " " * nat(5 - int(#number)) + number + " ")
    for: p < sim.size
        put(&line, 8 * p + 6, "|")
    own := 8 * process_index + 6
    symbols := ["*", "x", "S", "B", "R", "#"]
    put(&line, own, symbols[kind])
    if kind == 5
        put(&line, own + 1, shot_name)
    elif kind == 2 or kind == 3
        put(&line, own + 1, message_name(message))
    elif kind == 4
        other := 8 * source + 6
        low := minimum(other, own)
        high := maximum(other, own)
        for: low + 1 <= position < high
            put(&line, position, (if (position - 6) % 8 == 0 then "+" else "-"))
        put(&line, (if other < own then high - 1 else low + 1), (if other < own then ">" else "<"))
        put(&line, low + 2, message_name(message))
    return trimmed(line)

string event_diagram(Event event, int value, Simulation sim)
    source := if event.kind == 4 then sim.packets[event.packet].source else -1
    return diagram_entry(value, event.process_index, event.kind, event.message, source, "", sim)

string[] diagram_lines(Simulation sim)
    lines := [diagram_header("t", sim.topology.names)]
    for entry := sim.timeline[]
        if entry[0] == 0
            event := sim.events[entry[1]]
            lines = lines.append(event_diagram(event, event.occurred_at, sim))
        else
            lines = lines.append(diagram_entry(entry[3], entry[2], 5, -1, -1, sim.shots[entry[1]].name, sim))
    lines = lines.append(diagram_header("L", sim.topology.names))
    count := int(#sim.events)
    keys := [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then (sim.events[i].lamport * sim.size + sim.events[i].process_index) * (count + 1) + i]
    for key := keys.sorted()[]
        event := sim.events[key % (count + 1)]
        lines = lines.append(event_diagram(event, event.lamport, sim))
    return lines

void save(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void run()
    topology := network.read_topology()
    processes.Script[] scripts := processes.read_scripts(topology.names)
    params := load_params()
    normal := Simulation(topology, scripts, params, false)
    .normal.schedule()
    .normal.run()
    raw := Simulation(topology, scripts, params, true)
    .raw.schedule()
    .raw.run()
    save("trace.txt", trace_lines(normal))
    save("deliveries.txt", deliveries_lines(normal))
    save("snapshots.txt", snapshots_lines(normal, raw))
    save("analysis.txt", analysis_lines(normal, raw))
    save("diagram.txt", diagram_lines(normal))

run()

int name_index(string[] names, string name)

class Channel(int source, int destination, bool fifo, int low, int high, int size)
    sequence := 0
    last_arrival := 0
    messages := 0
    markers := 0
    buffered := 0
    max_delay := 0
    entries := 0
    int[] previous := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]

class Topology(string[] names, Channel[] channels, int[] order)

Topology read_topology()
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/topology.txt"))
    rows := content.split(NL)
    header := rows[0].split(" ")
    names := header[1:<int(#header)]
    size := int(#names)
    channels := [for i := (0:<int(size * size))[] then Channel(i / size, i % size, true, 0, 0, size)]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#rows) - 1
        fields := rows[i].split(" ")
        source := name_index(names, fields[1])
        destination := name_index(names, fields[2])
        low := integer(fields[4])
        high := if #fields == 6 then integer(fields[5]) else low
        channels[source * size + destination] = Channel(source, destination, fields[3] == "FIFO", low, high, size)
    int[] order := []
    for: source < size
        for: destination < size
            if source != destination
                order = order.append(source * size + destination)
    return Topology(names, channels, order)

class Generator(int state)
    draws := 0

    int .draw()
        state = (48271 * state) % 2147483647
        draws += 1
        return state

int[] dispatch(Channel &channel, int now, bool marker, int[] vector, Generator &generator)
    channel.sequence += 1
    delay := channel.low
    if channel.low != channel.high
        delay += .generator.draw() % (channel.high - channel.low + 1)
    arrival := now + delay
    if channel.fifo and channel.last_arrival > arrival
        arrival = channel.last_arrival
    if arrival > channel.last_arrival
        channel.last_arrival = arrival
    if arrival - now > channel.max_delay
        channel.max_delay = arrival - now
    if marker
        channel.markers += 1
    else
        channel.messages += 1
        for: i < int(#vector)
            if vector[i] != channel.previous[i]
                channel.entries += 1
        channel.previous = vector
    return [channel.sequence, arrival]

string delay_text(Channel channel)
    return if channel.low == channel.high then string(channel.low) else "{channel.low}-{channel.high}"

int integer(string text)
    result := int(text)
    return result

int name_index(string[] names, string name)
    for: i < int(#names)
        if names[i] == name
            return i
    return -1

class Action(string kind, int destination, string text, int amount)

Action parse_action(string[] fields, string[] names)
    kind := fields[0]
    if kind == "LOCAL" or kind == "BROADCAST" or kind == "SNAPSHOT"
        return Action(kind, -1, fields[1], 0)
    destination := name_index(names, fields[1])
    if kind == "TRANSFER"
        return Action(kind, destination, "transfer", integer(fields[2]))
    return Action(kind, destination, fields[2], 0)

class Scheduled(int start, int period, Action action)
class Rule(string tag, Action action)
class Script(int initial)
    Scheduled[] at := []
    Rule[] on := []

Script[] read_scripts(string[] names)
    content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/programs.txt"))
    rows := content.split(NL)
    Script[] scripts := []
    for row := rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1][]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        key := fields[0]
        if key == "PROCESS"
            scripts = scripts.append(Script(integer(fields[3])))
        elif key == "AT"
            current := int(#scripts) - 1
            recurring := fields[2] == "EVERY"
            period := if recurring then integer(fields[3]) else 0
            first := if recurring then 4 else 2
            scripts[current].at = scripts[current].at.append(Scheduled(integer(fields[1]), period, parse_action(fields[first:<int(#fields)], names)))
        elif key == "ON"
            current := int(#scripts) - 1
            scripts[current].on = scripts[current].on.append(Rule(fields[1], parse_action(fields[2:<int(#fields)], names)))
    return scripts

class State(Script script, int size)
    initial := script.initial
    balance := script.initial
    lamport := 0
    int[] vector := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]
    int[] broadcast := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]
    int[] events := []
    int[] next_sequence := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 1]
    int[][] reorder := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then []]
    int[] holdback := []
    int[] delivered := []
    max_held := 0
    received := 0
    sent := 0
    refused := 0
    minimum := script.initial
    counts := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]

int[][] expand(State[] states, int limit)
    int[][] result := []
    for: p < int(#states)
        for: line < int(#states[p].script.at)
            entry := states[p].script.at[line]
            now := entry.start
            while now <= limit
                result = result.append([now, p, line])
                if entry.period == 0
                    break
                now += entry.period
    return result

int balance_at_cut(int initial, int[] event_balances, int count)
    return if count == 0 then initial else event_balances[count - 1]

int held_count(State state)
    result := int(#state.holdback)
    for buffer := state.reorder[]
        result += int(#buffer)
    return result

class Record(bool valid, int recorded_at, string reason, int balance, int lamport, int[] vector, int[] pending)

class Snapshot(string name, int start, int size)
    complete := -1
    records := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then Record(false, 0, "", 0, 0, [], [])]
    int[][] states := [for i := (0:<int(size * size))[] then []]
    int[] marker_sent := [for i := (0:<int(size * size))[] then -1]
    int[] marker_accepted := [for i := (0:<int(size * size))[] then -1]
    accepted := 0
    int[][] ignored := []

void capture(Snapshot &snapshot, int process_index, int now, string reason, int balance, int lamport, int[] vector, int[] pending)
    snapshot.records[process_index] = Record(true, now, reason, balance, lamport, vector, pending)

void accept(Snapshot &snapshot, int channel, int now)
    snapshot.marker_accepted[channel] = now
    snapshot.accepted += 1
    if snapshot.accepted == snapshot.size * (snapshot.size - 1)
        snapshot.complete = now

int[] snapshot_cut(Snapshot snapshot)
    return [for p := (0:<int(snapshot.size))[] then snapshot.records[p].vector[p]]

class Details(int[] orphans, int[] transit, int balances, int money)

Details details(int[] cut, int[][] copies, int[][] event_balances, int[] initial)
    int[] orphans := []
    int[] transit := []
    balances := 0
    amounts := 0
    for: i < int(#copies)
        copy := copies[i]
        sent := copy[2] <= cut[copy[0]]
        received := copy[3] > 0 and copy[3] <= cut[copy[1]]
        if received and not sent
            orphans = orphans.append(i)
        if sent and not received
            transit = transit.append(i)
            amounts += copy[4]
    for: p < int(#cut)
        balances += if cut[p] == 0 then initial[p] else event_balances[p][cut[p] - 1]
    return Details(orphans, transit, balances, balances + amounts)

int[][] recorded(Snapshot snapshot, int[] channel_order)
    int[] entries := []
    int[] pending := []
    for channel := channel_order[]
        entries = entries.concat(snapshot.states[channel])
    for record := snapshot.records[]
        pending = pending.concat(record.pending)
    return [entries, pending]

bool transit_match(int[] entries, int[] pending, int[] transit)
    return entries.concat(pending).sorted() == transit.sorted()

bool vector_consistent(Snapshot snapshot, int[] cut)
    for record := snapshot.records[]
        for: i < int(#cut)
            if record.vector[i] > cut[i]
                return false
    return true
